name: minemodcraft
description: マイクラのMOD・アドオンをコード無しで作れるビジュアル開発スタジオ（非公式ツール）
author: CUBICENGINEstudio

scripts.build:sprout:win: npm run check:clean && cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT electron-builder --win --config.appId=com.cubicengine.sprout --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=sprout --publish never
scripts.build:sprout:mac: npm run check:clean && cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT electron-builder --mac --config.appId=com.cubicengine.sprout --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=sprout --publish never
scripts.build:grove:win: npm run check:clean && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE electron-builder --win --config.appId=com.cubicengine.grove --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=grove --publish never
scripts.build:grove:mac: npm run check:clean && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE electron-builder --mac --config.appId=com.cubicengine.grove --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=grove --publish never
scripts.build:grove:appx: npm run check:clean && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE electron-builder --win appx --config.appId=com.cubicengine.grove --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=grove --publish never
scripts.build:all:win: npm run build:sprout:win && npm run build:grove:win
scripts.build:all:mac: npm run build:sprout:mac && npm run build:grove:mac
scripts.build:all: npm run build:all:win && npm run build:all:mac
scripts.android:build: cross-env MMC_TARGET=android NEXT_PUBLIC_MMC_STORE=1 next build && npm run verify:store && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:build && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run check:clean && npm run android:build && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: cross-env MMC_TARGET=android NEXT_PUBLIC_MMC_STORE=1 next build && npm run verify:store && cap sync ios
